_doc: Identity-lock references and account links for Reginald. `bin/studio seed` upserts the character and its accounts from this file. status: designing | live | paused (the daily run skips anything but live; flip to live at go-live). closeup, closeup_center and blue_eye_xy stay null until the eye close-up is generated in the rehearsal (Task 16). An account with a null handle is not seeded yet; an account with no postiz_integration_id is skipped by planning. dropin_share is the first-insert value: the Instagram guard and the terminal change it later and a re-seed leaves it alone.
